content_sections.text: Four years Bachelors Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / Masters Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / BVSc / BPharm or bachelors degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent and Four years experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services OR Masters Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized university or equivalent AND Two years experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services OR Doctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Pharma / MD / Master of Surgery from a recognized University or equivalent. Experience in at least two of: Optimization, Game Theory, Control and Power Systems. Excellent programming skills in Python or MATLAB.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kharagpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Senior Project Associate - Research recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Senior Project Associate - Research position at IIT Kharagpur is 12th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Project Associate - Research post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Project Associate - Research position as per the official notification released by IIT Kharagpur for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this role?
faq.answer: The educational qualification includes a Bachelors Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences or a Masters Degree in Engineering or Technology, along with specific years of experience in R&D. Detailed qualifications are provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Project Associate - Research position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Project Associate - Research post is 40 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per sponsor agency rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive as per the provided information.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Senior Project Associate - Research position at IIT Kharagpur is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Senior Project Associate - Research at IIT Kharagpur is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. What are the desirable qualifications for the Senior Project Associate - Research role?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include a B.Tech/M.Tech/PhD in Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation/Computer Science with a minimum CGPA of 7.00 or 70% marks, and experience in Optimization, Game Theory, Control and Power Systems, along with programming skills in Python or MATLAB.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
